full_details: At the Cross Keys in the morning Garnish held the scene at six entrances and would not read a seventh. You denied the throat once, and you played the Knave at two. Edith's eight shillings was spoken as still owing till Lady Day. The Queen's twenty pound was named only to say it is not had, and not yours. Sam's winter doublet is too tight. The Rose bill was the Siege of London. You did not go. At home after dark you struck one pleased line in the fifth act. You did not write the songs, and you did not write the last line.
one_sentence: You rehearsed at nine with a thick throat and played the Knave at two.
title: Rehearsed with a thick throat and played the Knave
